description: List the Discussion comments on a program brief — the same threaded comments the console renders on the program. Oldest first; resolved comments are included (each carries its `resolved` flag and `anchor`). A comment written by a shared-report reader is marked `external: true` and shows the author's display name only (never an email). Read-only. ONE PAGE per call (50 by default, 100 max): the result carries `meta` with `hasMore`, `nextCursor` and `appliedFilters`. When `meta.hasMore` is true, pass `meta.nextCursor` back as `cursor` to get the next page.
name: anyforge_list_program_comments
title: List program comments
